summary.text: Jill Billings is a Democratic member of the Wisconsin State Assembly who has represented District 95 since 2011 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026, general election.
She previously served on the La Crosse County Board.

paragraphs.text: Jill Billings served as a La Crosse County supervisor and as vice chair of the La Crosse County Board.
She has also served as a teacher for the Friendship Program, teaching English to the Hmong community.
Billings has served in the Assembly since 2011.
In the 2025-2026 session she serves on the Agriculture, Children and Families, and Tourism committees.
